summary: A snowmobiler was caught and injured in an avalanche on the Hourglass Path near Wolf Creek Pass.
location: Hourglass Path near Wolf Creek Pass
notes: KVNF relayed a CAIC report on March 1, 2023. February 25 is an approximate date based on the surrounding weekend avalanche reporting; the KVNF paragraph explicitly dates the Vallecito avalanche but does not separately date this event. No responding agency or rescue outcome was reported beyond the injury.
